key_findings: Compound 194 blocks CRMP2 SUMOylation, promoting NaV1.7 endocytosis and selectively reducing NaV1.7 currents in DRG neurons.
Oral and spinal 194 is antinociceptive across models, requires opioid receptor signaling, and lacks addiction or toxicity signals.
